title: Montserrat All Day Private Tour with Manuel, Private Car
text: My husband, daughter and myself planned a ten day trip to Barcelona as a family vacation.   Fortunately, I found Manuel and his private car service online before we left. This was a great decision as Manuel made the entire 8 hour day hassle free!  He picked us up at our hotel and explained the history of our surroundings in detail on the one hour drive there.  He is a kind, wonderful, family man and his English is perfect!   Thanks to Manuel knowing all the ins and outs, we were able to see the Black Madonna, hear the Boys Choir, tour the property, take tons of pictures, and tour the beautiful
author: Claudia S
